_doc: Paths in cloud-u-containers that are not container services and never ship as an image: `dirs` (top-level directories) and `files` (exact repo-root files). A dispatch whose every changed path is one of these is a proven no-op (verdict=nothing-to-ship), not verdict=empty. _dispatch ships by git pull of the shared tree; .github/.githooks/.gitleaks.toml are repo plumbing emitted by cloud-infra's fleet build (#760: a push of only those went red as 'empty', run 36961619053).
